rules.conflict_note: Page gives no ordinance number or effective date; says first reading Feb. 17, final vote set for March 3, 2026.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits
rules.exemptions: Pricing software relying solely on publicly available data or aggregate historical data; tools used to comply with affordable housing program requirements
rules.citation: Santa Ana algorithmic rent-setting software ordinance (2026)
rules.title: Santa Ana ban on algorithmic rent-setting software
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; $1,000 per violation
rules.requirement: Selling, licensing, providing or using algorithmic rent-setting software that relies on nonpublic competitor data is banned for Santa Ana residential rentals. Tenants can sue for injunctive relief, damages or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation plus attorney's fees, and need only prove use of the prohibited technology.
rules.quoted_span: prohibits the sale, licensing, provision and use of certain algorithmic rent-setting software for residential rental properties.

notes: No ordinance number or effective date on page; effective_date null. Status in_force assumed since the final vote was scheduled for 2026-03-03 (X008 confirms final passage).
